note: ZAICODE pixel-exact fonts. Installed per user (no admin) by the ZAICODE launcher and the ZAICODE main process when missing. Both carry embedded bitmap strikes (EBLC), which Chromium/DirectWrite draws aliased: crisp pixels without anti-aliasing on any machine. Web fonts (@font-face) lose these strikes (Chromium's font sanitizer drops EBLC/EBDT), so they must be installed fonts.
